text:
carmen: walked into the office like a confident engineer then my editor whispered: > tab detected. everything changed. :sweat_smile:

dev-jenkins: Build #872 failed: validate-yaml -> config/infra.yaml:35 Unexpected tab character. See logs: https://ci.redwood/reports/872

ivy: the classic. was it an intentional tab (artisanal) or a sneaky copy-paste?

carmen: suspect: copy-paste from someone's notes that looked suspiciously like markdown. rip semantic version too: package.json shows "version": "v2.0" (no semver, all feelings).

oleg: rest in peace semver. We should teach deploy-bot to respond with a GIF instead of failing hard. morale would be higher. :joy:

tess: feature request: linter that converts compiler error messages into dad jokes. e.g., "Unexpected token? Maybe it just needed a hug."

ivy: also enforce .editorconfig + normalize-whitespace pre-commit. 2 spaces = happiness.

carmen: opened PR #601: "normalize-config-whitespace". adding a tiny note in the PR description: "sorry for the tab, it was a rogue keystroke."

dev-jenkins: @carmen opened PR #601. Checks queued. To re-run build: `ci retry 872`. :gear:

oleg: vote: mandatory haiku penalty for whitespace sins? +1 for haiku.

carmen: haiku incoming:
"a lonely tab hides
midnight deploy blinks and cries
spaces bring sunrise"

tess: perfect. closing thread with a meme: "When the compiler is passive-aggressive" (attached: grumpy cat SVG).
